name: study
description: Study skills on top of a research knowledge base: map what past exams ask (exam-map), write printable Word/PDF summaries weighted by the exams (study-summary), create mock exams with separate solutions (mock-exam), solve exams and exercise sheets with the course's own material (solve-exam), mark attempts while tracking weak spots (correct-attempt), run adaptive quizzes in the chat (quiz), make Anki flashcards (flashcards) and plan the study up to the exams (study-plan).
